steps.content:
Two weeks after a raid
MBCC Chief's office
You stare at the report freshly submitted today containing only a familiar sentence.
<i>"The heist will go on as planned on XX/XX at the usual spot in Syndicate. First come, first served."<i>
Two days ago, the MBCC's informant in Syndicate got wind that the local street gangs were plotting a heist.

steps.speaker: Intelligence Agent
steps.content: The contact could only dig up so much information. Now, all we know is that this heist is related to Mania weapons.

steps.speaker: Intelligence Agent
steps.content: But after several raids, those old hands have become more careful with their communication. The exact location of the usual spot remains untraceable to us.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What about the source of the Mania weapons?

steps.speaker: Intelligence Agent
steps.content: Unknown. The circulation of Mania weapons in Syndicate mainly relies on the black market and underground banks, but we've observed no records of large-scale transactions on these two networks recently.
You frown. If you can't pinpoint the exact location of the conflict, there's still nothing you can do despite having foresight of the impending disaster.
It's three days before the date in the intel. You've tried everything but still come up empty-handed.
Knock, knock.
The knocks on the door interrupt your thoughts. It's Nightingale.
She walks in, places a stack of files on the desk, and reports the results of the investigation.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: I have good news and bad news.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The bad news is that we've sifted through all of our informants in Syndicate but to no avail.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The good news, which is in a way worse news, is that Sinner Golan who you've been keeping an eye on has been demonstrating many suspicious behaviors possibly related to this matter.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Not only did she go AWOL during a field mission, but she also triggered numerous sensitive keywords while browsing the dark web, including Mania weapon, Syndicate, Iron Gang, Bridgehead, and gang brawl.
When you first got the tip-off, you had already interrogated several Sinners with past connections to Syndican gangs, but didn't get any useful answers.
Among this group of Sinners interrogated, Golan's questioning went the fastest, because her file was just too clean.
Unknown origin, unknown criminal record, and stable M-value. The only point relevant to this case is that the whistleblower of the heist was frequently spotted near Golan's rented home.
At first, you thought it was just a coincidence, but after Nightingale submitted the report on Golan's recent abnormal behaviors, you feel things might not be so simple.
Two pages into the report and you ask Nightingale to arrange an urgent meeting with Golan.
Under the dim light, Golan sits twisted, mumbling something to herself while struggling with the loosened ribbons on her clothes.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: First, make a loop with the left end and hold it down! Then weave the right end under the left end and straighten it. F... I got it wrong again. Oh! You're here.
The smooth cursing takes a sharp turn and gets stifled. Seeing you walk in, she immediately swallows what she's about to say and assumes a demure, ladylike demeanor.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Why the sudden meeting call? And in such a scary place, no less.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Don't forget I'm a straight-A Sinner. I always follow the rules and stay away from the dodgy stuff.
It's that feigned obedient look again. If you hadn't read that ten-page-long record of her recent abnormal behaviors, you might have been fooled.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: A straight-A Sinner wouldn't sneak to the computer in the middle of the night to search for news about Syndican gangs, would she?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Bridgehead, Deluge, Iron Gang, Nine Dragons Teahouse, Cripple Alley... I'm afraid you can't even find such an exhaustive list of gangs in the MBCC's archives.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: B-but isn't this common knowledge to all Syndicans? Haha...

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: I, I only heard others mention them before and got curious. I swear I'm not up to anything...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: My investigation shows that besides the Bridgehead and the Iron Gang, the rest of the gangs have limited influence and are little known both online and among the general public.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I think you already knew information on those small gangs was scarce when you searched them... Only those who have encountered them on their turf know about them.
You thought pointing out her unusual knowledge of Syndican gangs would make this conversation easier. After all, most people give up denying when faced with conclusive evidence.
But instead, Golan starts looking for more excuses after seeing the evidence. You know you must quickly find a hole in her defense to smoothen this interrogation.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Oh, it's my poor memory again! Now that I think about it, an online friend on the dark web probably told me about them.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: An ordinary girl like me would never dare to wander into territories controlled by gang bosses, let alone encounter them. Just the thought of it terrifies me!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But somehow going AWOL during a field mission to chat with the old man who passed on gang gossip didn't terrify you.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Ahaha... I admit I can be a bit too carefree sometimes. I just love having a casual chat with kind old people.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: And during that casual chat, did you hand him a note to warn him about something unusual and ask him to notify the old lady running the shop at 201 Cross Street?

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Tell you what, Old Rick likes Miss Sylvia. I was simply playing matchmaker for the two seniors.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What about that photo of the two of you in the old lady's shop, then? She said you always brought the Iron Gang underlings over to buy ice cream and that everyone said you were the best boss lady in the world.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: You... She...

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: ...Sigh, Sylvia's too careless. How could she tell the cops everything...
It seems confirmed that Golan is involved with Syndicate's Iron Gang.

You don't have time to delve into her relationship with the gang. From the current info, Golan at least knows about the Mania weapons and the recent brawls happening in Syndicate. You must get more relevant intel out of her.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: So you're a member of the Iron Gang, and recently you've racked up so many violations all pointing to Syndicate, gangs, and Mania weapons.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Are you planning to seize Mania weapons? With the Legion gone, if the Iron Gang wants to take this opportunity to rise as the top gang in Syndicate, Mania weapons are necessary. Am I right?
Realizing you're already treating her like a de facto gang member, Golan also drops her disguise and looks at you a bit derisively.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Pfft, as if the Iron Gang cares about this kind of title.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Moreover, with the Iron Gang's strength, they don't need Mania weapons to win the turf war. Only those losers would resort to these despicable means on the battlefield.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: The Iron Gang has always fought bravely and honorably.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It seems the Iron Gang really is something.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Hmph, you don't say!
Golan lifts her chin and snorts with evident pride.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But if the opposing gang uses Mania weapons in the fight, the Iron Gang will naturally need something even more powerful to counter honorably, right?

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: ...What do you mean?
Golan suddenly falls silent, but soon she laughs again, stroking her head.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Oh, but that's impossible!

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: There are no more mass destruction Mania weapons left in Syndicate. Not long ago, they already used up the ones stashed away.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: The Iron Gang... They're just...
Golan seems to recall something unpleasant and stops mid-sentence.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Did something happen?

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: ...Anyway, don't worry about it. They wouldn't dare touch Mania weapons again.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Those damned things do almost as much harm to yourself as to the enemies and often lead to uncontrollable consequences.

steps.speaker: FAC Captain
steps.content: Unless they're planning a suicide attack, the deterrent and cost resulting from wielding a Mania weapon are just not worth it. Better to just snatch a ready-made weapon.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Unless all those hits have finally wrecked their brains, those guys with their short-sighted plans will never mess with Mania weapons again.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Well, the good stuff that's more stable, more lethal, reusable, and aims better, of course.
Such an ideal mass destruction weapon doesn't even exist in the entire DisCity, let alone in Syndicate.
You start to wonder if Golan is pulling your leg, but she speaks so firmly as if she's really seen it... used it, even.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: So, whose hands is it in now?

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: In the most unexpected place, of course!

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Those ******* think they can kick the Iron Gang down a peg and sit on the throne if they snatch it.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: ******* idiots! It's already flown away like a butterfly...
Golan eyes you with a grin, looking indifferent about this coveted weapon everyone's fighting over and even quite happy about its disappearance.
Even more strangely, according to her, the Iron Gang seems uninterested in the weapon either.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: If it's really so great, then why doesn't the Iron Gang want to seize it too?

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: They... They're capable enough. The use of this kind of thing will only hold them back.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: The Iron Gang doesn't need this flashy... stuff. Rather, its members despise it, whether it's Mania weapons, or...
Golan mumbles and stops on something unintelligible.
But her unconscious annoyance at the mention of this weapon reminds you of something else you learned before entering the interrogation room.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Is the Iron Gang's aversion toward it related to the death of their heiress?

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: What did you say?
Golan freezes momentarily upon hearing that. Her eyes widen in disbelief and her fingertips start to tremble uncontrollably.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: They're saying the Iron Gang's heiress is dead?
She still looks dazed, but the sharp alarm of the M-value detector reveals her true feelings at the moment.
Golan's sudden outburst and her familiarity with the Syndican gangs, especially the Iron Gang, make you realize something...

options: Is she someone important to you?

choices.text: Is she someone important to you?

steps.content: The shock still hasn't left her completely, but she nods slightly.
Her emotions are so thoroughly exposed that she can't hide them anymore.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'm sorry you had to hear about your friend this way.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: ...I'm fine. It's a good thing. This might be a relief for her.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But the MBCC's received a tip-off that there will be a riot to seize Mania weapons in Syndicate in two days. The word about this got out just a day after the Iron Gang announced the death.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: My speculation is that the Iron Gang wanted to cover something up with the heiress's death, but this act angered the other gangs. The upcoming riot has also arisen because of that dead heiress.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: The riot is in two days?

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: But she, she's... Whatever she might have to do with the ready-made weapon, she's already dead.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It's not hard to deduce from your words that the ready-made weapon is powerful. If the heiress had any connection to it, then surely the gangs wouldn't let her go, dead or alive.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: They might not even believe she's dead. If the Iron Gang is indeed their target, then they're probably planning to turn it upside down.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Damn... These ******* bastards!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: So, is there any more information you can give me? I want to stop the riot over the Mania weapons, and you want to protect the Iron Gang. I think our goals are aligned.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: ...I've told you what you need to know. You've broken it down more completely than I ever can.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Thanks to you, I've finally got a clearer idea of their plan.
Having digested your analysis of the situation, Golan gradually turns serious.
She lowers her head, seemingly deliberating over something.
You catch the moment she makes a silent promise to herself.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: Oh, but what can I do? I'm all locked up here now. My hands are tied.

steps.speaker: Golan
steps.content: I'm only thinking...
It seems you can't get more information from Golan, so you decide to end the conversation.
Now that you've confirmed the upcoming heist might be related to the Iron Gang, you should start planning your response.

One day later
MBCC Chief's office
A call from Nightingale.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, at 5:10 p.m. today, Sinner Golan broke free from her restraints and went AWOL on a field mission. Currently, her whereabouts are unknown.
You sigh. You knew Golan had been hiding something when the interrogation ended yesterday.
You believe Golan wouldn't lie to you, but whether it's for Mania weapons or that ready-made weapon she mentioned, the imminent heist will surely spark a gang riot.
But at least, you now know where to find Golan and uncover the truth.
